description: ILibraryManager calls per home-path request, counted by PerfBudgetTests (PROC-02.c) over a fixed fake library of 20 movies, a fixed clock (2026-10-18) and one enabled row per registered widget type, with the scoring snapshot and collections index warmed first. A count must equal its budget: lower it in the commit that lowers the count; raise it only with a 'Budget: <reason>' trailer (ci/static-checks.mjs). Widget types that render no section on this library (next-up, recently-added rows, my-media, admin collection and studio, favorite actor and director, TMDb rows) are counted in the layout build only.
